faqs.question: Who can apply for IdeaVerse 2.0?
faqs.answer: Student founders and emerging startups from Iqra University, Karachi, and cities across Sindh are eligible to apply.

faqs.question: Can startups outside Iqra University participate?
faqs.answer: Yes! IdeaVerse 2.0 welcomes eligible startups from any recognized institute or city in Sindh.

faqs.question: Can teams outside Karachi participate?
faqs.answer: Yes. Non-Karachi teams in Sindh participate via Virtual Pitching rounds. If selected, they may be invited to the physical Showcase Marquee.

faqs.question: What is the maximum team size?
faqs.answer: A team can consist of a maximum of 4 members including the Team Lead.

faqs.question: What startup stage is required?
faqs.answer: Startups must at minimum have a Prototype or MVP/Product Ready stage. Pure napkin/idea-stage concepts without a working prototype are not eligible.

faqs.question: Does submitting an application mean I have been selected?
faqs.answer: No. Submitting an application enters your startup into the screening phase. Shortlisted teams will be officially notified before pitching rounds.

faqs.question: Will there be prize money?
faqs.answer: Prize details and awards will be officially announced once final sponsorship packages are confirmed. Details can be viewed in the Prize Pool section.

faqs.question: When will shortlisted startups be contacted?
faqs.answer: Dates for screening announcements will be shared with applicants via email and WhatsApp after applications close.
